Image4 is the accepted-pose four-frame EAST/right-facing walk strip, but its alpha has BAD brown blocky translucent halos outside the silhouettes. Remove those exterior brown/black blocks and haze completely, restoring truly transparent alpha=0 everywhere outside the four characters.

Do NOT redraw or reset frames3/4 to frames1/2. Do NOT change their legs or expressions. This is ONLY background/alpha cleanup, not a new pose design.
Inputs1/2/3 are the original identity master and Taoist hand-painted style guides, only to protect original character colors/material edges. The character's actual brown hair, cream cloth, gold trim, green boots and red tassel must stay opaque/soft-edged exactly as appropriate; remove ONLY the unwanted exterior haze. Preserve fine hair, ribbon, hand, tassel and shoe outlines with clean natural antialiasing. No shadow, glow, floor or colored matte.
